critical_code_review_comments: command_center_router.py `_period_counts` runs 12+ separate DB queries per period; called twice per /command-center request (24 queries). Fine at current scale (17 users, 1 org) but consider $facet aggregation once data grows into millions of records.
AlertCenter.jsx `act()` calls load() after ack/resolve — swallows errors from load(). Consider surfacing toast for reload failure so user isn't stuck on stale list.

CommandCenter.jsx uses `Number(v).toLocaleString()` in fmtVal but revenue with format='usd' does `Number(v).toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 0})` which strips cents — intentional for exec summary, but no unit indicator when value truncates (e.g. $1,234.99 shown as $1,235).
Admin360Panels.jsx Org360Drawer stats grid is grid-cols-3 with 6 stats — works, but 'Seats' label overflows on narrow drawer (fixed width sa-drawer). Minor visual only.

SuperAdminPortal.jsx: 12 tabs share one top-level useEffect(loadAll) that fetches /admin/orgs + /admin/users on every mount even when landing on non-orgs/users tabs (e.g. Command Centre) — small waste; lazy-load per-tab if perf becomes a concern.
command_center_router.py alert states collection `admin_alert_states` upsert never sets an `alerted_at` timestamp on first ack — hard to audit alert-timeline forensically. Minor observability gap.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seed org 'ITHR Technologies Consulting LLC' and existing 17 users). During testing, alert state was ack'd once then cleaned up. Final DB state: admin_alert_states collection empty (matches expected fresh state).
